copy.curiosityHook: With a ruthless drug lord's hit squad hunting him across town, how long can an innocent musician survive a lethal manhunt meant for a killer?
copy.description: Hoping to carry on his family's musical trade, an itinerant mariachi arrives in a Mexican border town seeking work, only to be mistaken for an armed hitman carrying weapons in an identical guitar case.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful action with moderate stakes and a stripped-down, gritty border-town atmosphere.
copy.whyWatch: Clocking in at a breathless 81 minutes, Robert Rodriguez's action thriller delivers pure kinetic momentum, turning a simple case of mistaken identity into a taut, dusty chase.

allowedMaterial: mariachi arriving in town seeking work
hitman Azul carrying concealed guns in a guitar case
mistaken identity by a local drug lord and his henchmen
excludedMaterial: ultimate outcome of the mariachi or his pursuit
later character deaths or third-act twists
